hero.p: On November 11, 2026, CNESSWORKS and the Declaration of Consciousness Movement will mark 1111 World Consciousness Day for Humanity through a global activation of Random Acts of Consciousness introducing the inaugural CNESS Conscious Product Certification™. Purpose-led organizations are invited to place one clearly defined product before a universal seven-pillar assessment of how consciously it has been conceived, created, sourced, delivered, experienced and continuously improved.

idea.label: The Idea
p: A product is not conscious in the human sense. Yet every decision embedded within it can reflect awareness, responsibility, dignity, transparency and long-term care.
Every material selected, person involved, process controlled, claim communicated, customer supported and impact created reveals something about the consciousness behind the product.
CNESS Conscious Product Certification examines whether responsible intent has become visible through credible practices, appropriate evidence, trustworthy outcomes and a commitment to improvement.
This is more than a certification badge. It is an opportunity to demonstrate that your organization creates not only commercial value, but responsible and conscious value for humanity.

For the inaugural 11✦11 launch, CNESSWORKS will invite eligible organizations to submit products for consideration as one of the first 108 Founding Conscious Products, the opening chapter of a movement advancing responsible, transparent, human-centred and conscious commerce.
Founding status recognises participation in the inaugural cohort. It does not lower the assessment threshold, replace evidence requirements or guarantee media inclusion.
lists: ✔ Approved certification seal and usage toolkit
✔ Selected 11✦11 launch, campaign and storytelling opportunities
founding.note: Participation in launch or media activities is subject to selection, scheduling, editorial considerations, and the applicable participation agreement.

evaluate.p: The CNESS Conscious Product Certification evaluates how consciously a product is designed, sourced, manufactured, packaged, and presented across seven pillars totalling 700 points.

pillars.title: Product Integrity And Safety
pillars.desc: Built to fulfil its intended purpose. Designed to reduce avoidable harm. Governed responsibly as it changes.

pillars.title: Human Value And Wellbeing
pillars.desc: Created with people in mind. Respectful of dignity, access and wellbeing. Considerate of everyone it touches.

pillars.title: Ethical Sourcing & Responsible Value Chain
pillars.desc: Know where it comes from. Choose partners with care. Create through fair and responsible practice.

pillars.title: Environmental Responsibility & Sustainability
pillars.desc: Use resources with restraint. Reduce waste and avoidable impact. Consider the whole lifecycle.

pillars.title: Quality Performance & Lifecycle Value
pillars.desc: Do what it promises. Deliver consistently and reliably. Learn, improve and endure.

pillars.title: Customer Trust & Support
pillars.desc: Speak clearly and truthfully. Make choice and use understandable. Stand by the customer after the sale.

pillars.title: Utility & Pain-Point Solutions
pillars.desc: Create value beyond the transaction. Understand the wider consequences. Improve impact with purpose and humility.

why.p: The public result should help customers and partners understand the certified scope, seven-pillar strengths, important limitations, evidence basis, validity and current status. The internal CIS-P 700 result supports evaluator consistency and improvement; it should not be used as a simplistic ranking across unrelated products, markets or sectors.

steps: Define the exact product, service, component, software version, subscription or approved product family.
Confirm legal eligibility and the applicable certification boundary.
Complete the universal core questions across the seven pillars.
Attach the most relevant evidence available for each material answer.
Respond only to targeted evaluator clarifications or evidence gaps
Receive an independent review and certification decision.
Publish a time-bound Product Trust Profile and follow the Conscious Improvement Roadmap.
journey.p: CNESS awards one public status: CNESS Conscious Product Certified™. Products that are not yet ready receive a confidential improvement pathway and may return after corrective action.

evidence.label: Evidence-based
evidence.h3: What You May Be Asked to Submit
evidence.p: CNESSWORKS evaluates the transparency, relevance, and validity of submitted supporting documentation rather than performing laboratory testing itself.

pathways.h3: How consciously is a product created and brought into the world?
p: The world has created standards for quality, safety, performance and sustainability. CNESSWORKS advances the next question: can the complete value journey of a product demonstrate conscious intent, responsible creation, trustworthy experience and accountable impact?
On 11✦11, 108 Founding Conscious Products will help open that question to the world - not by claiming perfection, but by making responsibility visible, evidence-led and continuously improvable.
One Earth. One Humanity. One Consciousness. One Shared Future.
